human: Lordaeron-style gold monogram on a steel shield with crossed swords and upright warhammer; kingly steel, blue cloth and gold. Keep the official monogram rather than replacing it with a lion.
dwarf: Dwarven stone-and-bronze geometric crest, upright warhammer, golden face or tankard relief and broad metal wings; carved stone, green inset, brass.
nightelf: Long silver crescent glaives framing the central moon orb, tall purple and silver crest, hanging dark feathers and wood; moonlit lavender and silver.
gnome: Copper angular engineering crest with cyan gem at top, crossed tools and a bottom cog, purple inset and small gold bolts.
draenei: Purple crystalline circular lattice with slender gold naaru glyph, luminous violet core and crystal shards.
worgen: Dark iron wolf-head shield with crimson rose and vine details, two burning lanterns at upper sides, Victorian Gilnean metalwork.
orc: Rugged round wooden shield bearing the Orc/Horde rune, two crossed axes, iron studs, tusks and red cloth.
scourge: Pale broken Forsaken face/mask before a cracked teal tombstone shield, spiked black arrows, tarnished gold skeletal decoration and dark purple cloth.
tauren: Tall tribal wood and hide totem shield with stylized horned motif, crossing spears, feathered tassels, leather bindings, warm wood and muted red.
troll: Elongated red white and turquoise tribal shield mask, crossed spears and voodoo fetishes with small purple flags.
bloodelf: Elegant tall crimson and gold phoenix/sun crest with cyan inset, pointed red gem and branching gold wings.
goblin: Green grinning mechanical goblin mask under a radial rack of chunky metal rockets, brass pipes, orange indicators, bright green alchemical energy.
pandaren: Green jade central disc and four small carved jade tokens, crossed bamboo staves, red cord, parchment charms, little gourds; retain the race page emblem.
dracthyr: Golden winged draconic sigil with sweeping horns, central blue-white star, red drapery and blue rune band; retain the race page emblem.
voidelf: Elongated ornate gold and dark violet shield with deep sapphire center and blue void flames curling from the upper sides.
lightforgeddraenei: Radiant ivory and gold geometric shield with tall sacred golden naaru sigil at top and luminous star inset at center.
darkirondwarf: Black iron diamond shield with glowing molten red-orange runes and channels, heavy dark geometric metalwork and short chains.
kultiran: Golden ship wheel and anchor crest on rich green sailcloth, coiled nautical rope and crossed navy handled weapons.
mechagnome: Heavy brass and steel gear crest with cyan central lens, hanging golden prongs, blue energy conduits and two small tesla coils.
nightborne: Elegant silver and indigo arcane filigree, three-petaled magenta flower at center, luminous cyan crescent and fine arcane runes.
highmountaintauren: Round painted tribal hide drum shield, large cream moose antlers, eagle at top, red cloth streamers and feathers.
magharorc: Brown hide and dark wood shield bearing the Orc rune, heavy crossed iron axes, fur, tusks and bone charms.
zandalaritroll: Bold golden geometric skull/loa shield, layered gold plate, small turquoise insets and carved ivory tusks.
vulpera: Small triangular desert talisman crest with gold inset, red wrapped cloth, stitched leather, beads, feathers and dangling little pouches.
earthendwarf: Broad symmetrical angular stone and bronze titan-forged crest, blue central diamond, deep blue geometric runes and hanging short chains.
haranir: Tall organic carved wooden mask/crest with prominent amber-orange luminous crown, sweeping red and brown horns, deep blue organic inlays, vines and pointed root lower tip.
